project.title: DINE102 - Merrill Gardens Dining Courses Course
project.description: Help the Merrill Gardens Server serve a 5-star meal. At the end of this eLearning, you will know the Merrill Gardens process for serving meals in courses and the importance of managing wait times and food temperatures. When the eLearning is complete meet with your Team Lead and learn more about best practices at your community. (6 minutes)
